zh.title: 巴西航空工業 Phenom 300EV 獲三地認證
zh.summary: Phenom 300EV 獲 ANAC、FAA、EASA 認證；2028年交付
body: 巴西航空工業（Embraer）於2026年8月25日宣布，Phenom 300EV 已獲得巴西國家民航局（ANAC）、美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）及歐洲航空安全局（EASA）的三重認證。
Phenom 300EV 於2025年7月推出，可搭載四名乘客，是 Phenom 300E 的演進機型，增加了有效載荷，航程從2,010海里增加到2,055海里（約3,722至3,806公里）。
該機型最突出的特色是標配 Garmin Autoland 系統。該安全功能在飛行員失能時可自動引導飛機降落至最近的機場，這將是光輕型噴射機類別中首款配備該新世代安全系統的機型。
Phenom 300EV 也將線配 GoGo Galileo 的低地球軌道（LEO）衛星連線，並可選配 Starlink。首批交付計畫訂於2028年。

en.title: Embraer Phenom 300EV with Autoland receives triple certification from ANAC, FAA, EASA
body: On August 25, 2026, Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer announced that the Phenom 300EV has obtained triple certification from the National Civil Aviation Agency of Brazil (ANAC), the United States (FAA), and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA).

Launched in July 2025 and carrying four passengers, the Phenom 300EV is an evolution of Embraer's light jet family, with increased payload and a longer range of 2,055 nautical miles (3,806 km) compared with the previous Phenom 300E's 2,010 nautical miles. The aircraft's most notable feature is the default installation of the Garmin Autoland system, which can automatically land the aircraft at the nearest airport if the pilot becomes incapacitated.
The Phenom 300EV will be line-fitted with Gogo Galileo low Earth orbit satellite connectivity, with optional Starlink. First deliveries to customers are planned for 2028.

facts.claim: Embraer announced on August 25, 2026, that the Phenom 300EV received triple certification from ANAC, the FAA, and EASA.
facts.sourceQuote: On August 25, 2026, Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer announced that the Phenom 300EV obtained triple certification, from the National Civil Aviation Agency of Brazil (ANAC), the United States (FAA), and the European Union (EASA).

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV was launched in July 2025 and carries four passengers.
facts.sourceQuote: Launched in July 2025 and capable of carrying four passengers, the Phenom 300EV is an evolution of Embraer’s popular light jet family

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV offers increased payload and longer range, from 2,010 to 2,055 nautical miles (3,722 to 3,806 km), compared to the Phenom 300E.
facts.sourceQuote: such as increased payload and slightly longer range (from 2,010 nautical miles to 2,055 nautical miles or 3,722 to 3,806 km)

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV will be the first light jet and largest jet aircraft equipped with the Garmin Autoland system, which lands automatically at the closest airport if the pilot is incapacitated.
facts.sourceQuote: The Garmin Autoland is a safety feature which makes it possible to land the aircraft automatically at the closest airport in case the pilot becomes incapacitated during the flight. The Phenom 300EV will be the first aircraft in the light jet category and the largest jet aircraft so far to be equipped with this new generation safety system.

facts.claim: The Phenom 300EV will be line-fitted with Gogo Galileo's LEO satellite connectivity, with Starlink as an option.
facts.sourceQuote: The new Phenom 300EV will also be line-fitted with Gogo Galileo’s low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite connectivity, with Starlink as an optional addition.

facts.claim: First deliveries of the Phenom 300EV are planned for 2028.
facts.sourceQuote: The first deliveries of Phenom 300EV jets to customers are planned for 2028.
